title: Some results on naive transcendence in the ring of integers modulo infinitely large primes
summary: This paper presents various transcendence results in the ring of integers modulo infinitely large primes $\mathcal{A}$. In the ring $\mathcal{A}$, one can consider two notions of transcendence. One is based on the notion of finite algebraic numbers introduced by Rosen, while the other is transcendence in the naive sense. It is known that transcendence in the latter sense automatically implies transcendence in the former sense.
